name: Puebla de Lillo (Spain)
description: Vertically divided by a line of two large indentations, green at the hoist of one third with a white fleur-de-lis and white at the fly.
history: The arms and flag of Puebla de Lillo were approved by the town council in 1999; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of two vertical stripes joined by two indentations, green with a white fleur-de-lis next to the hoist and white at the fly, in the proportion 1/3 and 2/3.

features.role: division indented with two large points
